caption: Egeskov Castle, Kværndrup
composition: Moated red-brick castle with copper spires · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the west bank, Egeskov's red-brick Renaissance walls and copper spires stand in the dark moat, with a rippled reflection rather than a mirror. The night is overcast, about 12.1°C, with a breeze near 14 km/h and no rain. A few windows are lit. Late-September lawns are dark; this is not a summer flower show, and the vehicle museum is not in the frame.
